result.summary: The image depicts a residential urban street with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, pedestrian visibility is compromised by vehicles parked directly adjacent to the crossing area.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Cars parked very close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs leading up to the crosswalk on both sides of the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to improve pedestrian visibility and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with mixed-use buildings and continuous sidewalks. However, the environment lacks basic safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, traffic control signs, or curb ramps at the intersection.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable to drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles close to the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past parked cars.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow urban street with mixed-use development and a marked zebra crosswalk. While the narrow roadway geometry naturally helps to calm traffic speeds, the environment lacks daylighting at the crossing and visible accessibility features such as curb ramps.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk (lack of daylighting) obstruct sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street adjacent to the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Accessibility Infrastructure
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps or tactile paving are present at the crossing point, creating barriers for users with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Curb edges at the foreground crosswalk

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk and install curb extensions to improve visibility and further shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped curb ramps to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by narrow, aging sidewalks and faded crosswalk markings at an uncontrolled intersection. Safety is compromised by significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles and a lack of accessible infrastructure like curb ramps.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the intersection corner block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the black SUV is parked

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk markings are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the side street in the center foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions creates a barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner of the sidewalk in the lower left foreground
